title: The Devastating Maryland Earthquake of July 16, 2010

body: I mentioned in passing on Friday that we in central Maryland were awakened at 5:04 a.m. by a 3.6 magnitude earthquake. My sister-in-law sent this photograph that accurately and fully conveys the unimaginable trauma and immeasurable devastation all residents of our region have been living with ever since. Pity us accordingly.
